title: England Over 40s Name Squad for Triple Crown 2026
summary: England Over 40s Cricket have named their 14-man squad for the Triple Crown 2026 at Bishop's Stortford CC, Hertfordshire, 28–30 July. Darren Stevens captains the side, with Sean Park as vice-captain.

title: England Over 40s Cricket and The Forty Club Confirm Development Understanding
summary: England Over 40s Cricket and The Forty Club (XL) have confirmed an informal development understanding — a shared commitment to keeping the Spirit of Cricket alive for players aged 40 and above.

title: England Name Squad for 3rd ODI Against India
summary: England Over 40s have named their 12-man squad for the 3rd ODI against India on 4th June at Hammerwich CC, Staffordshire. S. Park captains the side, with the match live streamed via NVplay from 12pm.

title: England Over 40s Cricket Announce Squad for IMC O40s World Cup 2026 in Guyana
summary: England Over 40s Cricket has announced its 16-player squad for the IMC O40s World Cup 2026 in Georgetown, Guyana, led by captain Darren Stevens. The tournament takes place from 17–31 October 2026.
